kind: Self-review plus independent computational interpretations; no separate human or agent referee.
verdict: Connectedness and exact prefix paths for the specified core remain insufficient; full budgeted closure is unresolved.

checked_boundaries.result: The accepted set is the union with the old noisy binary-center tubes, not a noiseless replacement.
Only center functions are spliced exactly. Splices of arbitrary old noisy inputs are not claimed to lie in this set.
Standard numeric binary address order is essential to the 2m+4 selector cost; arbitrary coordinate permutations are not included.
A whole fixed model must match a prefix. Maximize its first-failure time only after computing that model, not independently per address.

checked_boundaries.topic: No hidden SAT or arithmetic gate
checked_boundaries.result: Bottleneck minima, maxima, additions and final comparisons are ordinary gate networks with bit-width cost charged.
Unsigned infinity is 2^(m+1)-1 in the word circuit; full consistency is clamped to N+1 before interpreting prefix length.
Only local Boolean identities, identical-node sharing and identities valid for every unsigned word are used.

checked_boundaries.topic: Old geometry is invalid after enlargement
checked_boundaries.result: A radius-two ball plus a prefix step contains a three-free-bit cube. The new proof uses cardinality rather than the old separated-ball bound.
At m>=4k+3 the low-coordinate parity has at most 8k gates and distance at least N/4 from every exact splice; the new set still misses YES inputs.
Complete gate checks cover the stated 8/16-input cases. Larger cases compare numeric algorithms with explicit center sets. None is an asymptotic lower-bound proof.
